F_DG_1_JOURNAL_CEILING_CORRECTION.class: BLOCKING against the predecessor pair; CLOSED by this correction
F_DG_1_JOURNAL_CEILING_CORRECTION.what_was_wrong: The predecessor pair represented the fourth PROTECTED ceiling entry as an EXACT SINGLE WRAPPER LITERAL - `db/prepared/journal/0NN_00NN_tenancy_refusal_audit_insert_policy.sql` - as though appending one baseline unit produced exactly ONE new journal file. It does not. Appending one unit REWRITES EVERY EXISTING WRAPPER. An implementation working to that representation produces a diff of 103 files against a ceiling that describes 24 single files, and `pnpm ods:scope` fails CLOSED on the superset. The authority, not the implementation, is at fault.

MEASURED_PROOF.the_coupling: db/hosted/baseline-journal-wrapper.ts:211 builds every wrapper's second line as `-- GENERATED — DO NOT EDIT. Unit ${unit.ordinal}/${BASELINE_UNITS.length}: ${unit.id}`. The DENOMINATOR is the LIVE ARRAY LENGTH, so every wrapper's bytes depend on how many units exist in total, not only on its own unit.
MEASURED_PROOF.measured_by_reading_all_80_files_bytes: db/prepared/journal/ holds EXACTLY 80 files at INTEGRATION_SHA. SEVENTY-NINE of them carry a header matching `-- GENERATED — DO NOT EDIT. Unit <n>/79: `, spanning 001_0000_quick_husk.sql through 079_0066_multiorg_s1_founder_traceability.sql. EXACTLY ONE - 000_journal_bootstrap.sql - carries NO count pin: its header reads 'Unit ZERO of PHASE_BASELINE', it is not produced by buildJournalWrapper, and it is regenerated BYTE-IDENTICALLY.
MEASURED_PROOF.why_the_regeneration_is_forced: `pnpm journal:generate` regenerates every wrapper and `pnpm journal:verify` REGENERATES AND COMPARES BYTES. There is no partial-regeneration mode: a stale wrapper whose denominator still reads 79 fails journal:verify byte-for-byte. So the 79 rewrites are MANDATORY, not incidental.
MEASURED_PROOF.why_a_wrapper_count_pin_did_not_reveal_i: The predecessor DID correctly record, in BASELINE_GROWTH_CONSEQUENCE.what_moves_when_one_drizzle_unit_is_appended, that the 'prepared journal wrapper count (N+1)' is derived and moves automatically. What it did not ask is whether the EXISTING wrappers' BYTES also move. A count moving from 80 to 81 is one new file; a denominator moving from 79 to 80 is eighty changed files. Those are different facts and only the second one sizes the diff.

CORRECTION.ceiling_entry_becomes_a_PATTERN: The fourth protected ceiling entry is REPLACED by the pattern `db/prepared/journal/**`. The exact-wrapper literal is WITHDRAWN.
CORRECTION.the_wrappers_are_NOT_enumerated: BINDING. This addendum does NOT enumerate the 79 existing wrappers, and no successor may be required to. Enumerating them would (a) make the ceiling a 103-entry list that must be re-derived every time ANY lane appends a baseline unit, (b) allocate nothing useful, and (c) couple this node's authority to a file set that its own implementation regenerates mechanically.
CORRECTION.why_a_pattern_is_the_GOVERNED_form_here: PRECEDENT, not convenience. Predecessor authority ALREADY governs the journal family by pattern: the protected grant HPO-ODS-W2-25 frozen by v1.0.24 carries `db/prepared/journal/**` as one of its two patterns, and HPO-ODS-W2-01, HPO-ODS-W2-12 and HPO-ODS-W2-21 carry the identical pattern in the LIVE registry. The corrected ceiling entry is now literally one of the grant's own patterns, which is a tightening of the correspondence between ceiling and grant, not a loosening.
CORRECTION.the_INDEPENDENT_COMPENSATING_GATE: `pnpm journal:verify` is the closed-world control that makes the pattern safe. It regenerates EVERY wrapper from BASELINE_UNITS and compares BYTES, so the pattern cannot be used to smuggle an arbitrary edit into db/prepared/journal/: any byte in that directory that is not what the generator produces fails the gate. The pattern widens what ods:scope ADMITS; journal:verify independently pins what those admitted files may CONTAIN. Neither gate alone is sufficient and both are mandatory.

MANDATORY_GATES.journal:generate: MANDATORY. The implementation MUST regenerate the wrappers with the repository-native generator. Hand-editing any wrapper - including hand-editing 79 denominators - is a STOP.
MANDATORY_GATES.journal:verify: MANDATORY. It must be RUN and must PASS. It is the compensating control for the pattern and is not optional.
MANDATORY_GATES.baseline_wrapper_byte_exact_regeneration: MANDATORY. Every one of the 79 existing wrappers must differ from its current bytes ONLY in the header denominator the generator produces, and the new wrapper must be exactly what the generator produces. Byte-exactness is asserted by journal:verify, not by inspection.

F_DG_2_REFUSAL_EVENT_SEMANTICS_CORRECTIO.class: BLOCKING against the predecessor pair; CLOSED by this correction
F_DG_2_REFUSAL_EVENT_SEMANTICS_CORRECTIO.what_was_wrong: The predecessor froze ACTION and SUBJECT FORM as INDEPENDENT AXES - 'BOTH actions may legitimately occur with EITHER form ... They are independent axes and the policy must not couple them' (v1.0.24 REFUSAL_SUBJECT_CONTRACT.ACTION_SEMANTICS.forms_are_orthogonal_to_actions). Following that, it mapped lib/auth/database-context.ts's selectedOrganizationId===null site to FORM A of tenancy.membership.revalidation_refused. TWO defects follow: (1) an ordinary authenticated user who has simply not selected an organization yet - the normal onboarding state - would emit a MEMBERSHIP REVALIDATION REFUSED audit event, although no membership was revalidated and nothing was refused; and (2) the orthogonality claim leaves the policy unable to reject the action/form cross-product, which is the correlation the audit trail's truthfulness depends on.
F_DG_2_REFUSAL_EVENT_SEMANTICS_CORRECTIO.HPO_ADJUDICATION: ROUTINE_NO_SELECTED_ORG_IS_NOT_A_REFUSAL_EVENT. A refusal event requires a REFUSAL - something asked for and denied. An authenticated principal that has no selected organization has asked for nothing at that boundary. Normal onboarding and ordinary authenticated no-org state are NOT refusals and MUST NOT be audited as such.
F_DG_2_REFUSAL_EVENT_SEMANTICS_CORRECTIO.what_it_costs_and_why_that_is_correct: DISCLOSED. This adjudication means the audit trail does NOT contain a row for every occasion on which a principal resolved without an organization. That is the intended outcome: recording a non-event as a refusal would flood the trail with rows that assert something false, and a trail whose rows are not true is worth less than a smaller trail whose rows are. The DEFERRED_VERBS obligation is NOT narrowed by this - both verbs remain owned, both reason values remain reachable, and every genuine refusal is still recorded.
F_DG_2_REFUSAL_EVENT_SEMANTICS_CORRECTIO.consequence_for_the_migration: MIGRATION_DESIGN_CHANGE_REQUIRED=YES relative to the predecessor. The predecessor's WITH CHECK correlated reason to subject form but deliberately did NOT correlate ACTION to form. The corrected contract requires exactly that correlation. See AUDIT_LOG_POLICY_CONTRACT.

FORM_A.name: NO USABLE ORGANIZATION UUID SUPPLIED BY AN EXPLICIT SELECTION ATTEMPT
FORM_A.applies_when: An EXPLICIT organization-selection attempt supplies no usable UUID - absent, empty, or malformed / non-UUID.
FORM_A.REQUIRES_AN_EXPLICIT_ATTEMPT: BINDING, AND THIS IS THE CORRECTION. FORM A requires an EXPLICIT SELECTION ATTEMPT. The predecessor's governing_definition - 'NO VALID ORGANIZATION UUID ASSERTION EXISTS AT THIS REFUSAL BOUNDARY' - was true of the routine no-selected-org state as well, which is precisely how that state was mis-typed as a refusal. An attempt is required, not merely an absence.
FORM_A.do_not_manufacture_a_subject: CARRIED UNCHANGED from v1.0.24. Do NOT manufacture an organization subject merely because hostile or malformed input contained arbitrary bytes. The bytes are not an organization, and recording them as one would both lie and create a write-anything channel into entity_id.

FORM_B.name: VALID ORGANIZATION UUID, REQUIRED MEMBERSHIP ABSENT
FORM_B.applies_when: An EXPLICIT attempt supplies a VALID organization UUID, but the authenticated user lacks the required active membership in it.
FORM_B.entity_id: the exact attempted valid organization UUID
FORM_B.no_existence_lookup: CARRIED UNCHANGED from v1.0.24. No organization existence lookup may be added merely to emit this event. A deleted or nonexistent organization carrying a valid UUID remains OBSERVATIONALLY INDISTINGUISHABLE from ordinary non-membership.
FORM_B.why_organization_id_is_still_NULL_in_FOR: CARRIED UNCHANGED from v1.0.24. The row is an event ABOUT the attempted organization, never an event OWNED by that tenant. entity_id is DESCRIPTIVE SUBJECT METADATA ONLY.

TRANSACTION_AND_FAILURE_SEMANTICS.binding: HPO ADJUDICATION D. A refusal audit INSERT MUST NOT execute inside the transaction that resolves the request principal.
REQUIRED_ARCHITECTURE: 1. Resolve the principal and the membership refusal facts.
2. Allow the principal-resolution transaction to COMPLETE.
3. If a genuine membership revalidation refusal exists, emit the audit event under a SEPARATE repository-native authenticated identity context.
4. Only then return / throw / redirect according to the existing refusal path.
TRANSACTION_AND_FAILURE_SEMANTICS.why_the_separation_is_required: The principal-resolution transaction is the transaction that DECIDES the refusal. Writing the audit row inside it couples the observation to the decision: a failing audit insert would roll back or perturb the principal resolution itself, which would let the audit surface change what the authorization surface answers. The node's whole premise - S3_CORE_COMPATIBILITY - is that this node OBSERVES and RECORDS a decision it does not participate in making.
